author: ezpz-content
instruction_bn: সঠিক punctuation ও capital letter দিয়ে বাক্যটি আবার লেখো (Board: punctuation, 0.5×14)।

items.original: my mother said i love you my child
a: My mother said, "I love you, my child."
items.rule_bn: উক্তির আগে কমা, inverted comma, address-এর আগে কমা।

items.original: what a beautiful scene it is
a: What a beautiful scene it is!

items.original: he asked me where i was going
a: He asked me where I was going.
items.rule_bn: পরোক্ষ প্রশ্ন, তাই শেষে full stop; 'I' capital।

items.original: bangladesh india nepal and bhutan are neighbours
a: Bangladesh, India, Nepal and Bhutan are neighbours.

items.original: oh i have won the prize
a: Oh! I have won the prize.
Oh, I have won the prize!

items.original: the girls book is on the table
a: The girl's book is on the table.

items.original: he reads in class ten he is a good boy
a: He reads in class ten. He is a good boy.
items.rule_bn: দুটি আলাদা বাক্য full stop দিয়ে আলাদা করো; পরের বাক্য capital।
